description: One juggler step. An even n goes to its integer square root, and an odd n goes to the integer square root of its cube. 1 stays 1, 2 gives 1, 3 gives 5, 9 gives 27, and 10 gives 3. n runs from 1 to 1000000. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/juggler-step
